svg.text: An administrator sees eighteen of them; an employee’s sidebar is
eleven items long. The nav is the permission model, visible.
Connection stated — and payroll gated on it
Online, Offline or Syncing sits in the header, and a pay run
refuses to generate or finalise rather than fail halfway.
One search across the whole record
People, leave, payslips and documents from any screen:
an administrator arrives with a name, not a module.
The four numbers an administrator answers for
Headcount, leave awaiting a decision, the paid-days
liability carried, and last month’s payroll cost.
Cost over time, not only this month
Payroll is what a director and a funder ask about, so the
trend sits on the home screen, not inside a report.
Signed in as, and as what
The footer names the account and its role. Nothing
about who you are, or what you may do, is implicit.
